title: CONTRACT ROWS ARE ONE HEIGHT
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08, on the 4K CONTRACTS screenshot. A finished contract shows a CLAIM button on its progress line, and that button was a full size button in a small line, so the finished row stood about a third taller than every other row and the list looked uneven. The button is a little slimmer there now, and every contract row is the same height.
now: On the CONTRACTS list a finished contract with its CLAIM button is now the same height as the others.
